name: Vanguard Zoe
explanation: Vanguard's front line buys enough time for Zoe to scale into her three-item spike, which is why the comp overperforms into board-heavy lobbies rather than burst comps.

stageGuides.stage2: Play the strongest board you can and slam components on any front-line unit.
stageGuides.stage3: Hit level 6 at 3-2 and stabilise with a Vanguard pair before spending gold.
stageGuides.stage4: Level to 8 at 4-1 and roll to 30 gold for Zoe 2.

flexSlots.note: Any Sorcerer that keeps the breakpoint works when Lulu is contested.
